_comment: Off-balance-sheet items read from filing TEXT (lease, VIE, commitments, guarantees and equity-method notes), one record per item. XBRL-tagged items (RPO, purchase obligations, VIE maximum exposure, guarantees, equity-method investments) come from the automated feed and are not repeated here. Each record: ticker, item (leases_not_commenced | vie_unconsolidated | vie_consolidated | jv_equity_method_debt | spv | rvg | take_or_pay | guarantee | purchase_obligation | prepayment), amountUSDm (null when the filing gives none), basis (undiscounted | present_value | max_exposure | notional | carrying), asOf, filing {form, accn, url, section, page}, quote (the sentence the figure comes from), commence (for leases: from/to), counterparty, lookthrough {sharePct, amountUSDm, method} when a proportional view applies, accounting (ASC topic), tier T1, status needs_review | verified, verifiedBy, verifiedOn. Text-derived numbers stay needs_review until a second reading of the cited page confirms them (Claude routine or the owner). Oracle's items are read from the Oracle model's verified store (tools/oracle/data/obligations.json) by scripts/hyperscalers/build.mjs and are not duplicated here.

searched.note_en: Neither the August 31, 2026 10-Q nor the FY2026 10-K discloses lessor guarantees or residual value guarantees (searched 'guarantee', 'residual value'), per the Oracle model's store.
searched.note_es: Ni el 10-Q al 31 de agosto de 2026 ni el 10-K del AF2026 revelan garantías a arrendadores ni de valor residual (búsqueda 'guarantee', 'residual value'), según el almacén del modelo de Oracle.
